title: Karyotype of Cotton (Gossypium hirsutum)
description: Karyotype of Cotton (Gossypium hirsutum). 2n=52. DAPI-stained chromosomes (blue) at metaphase are stained with anti-CENH3 (red), which localizes to the centromere region.
author: Song Luo, Jennifer Mach, Bradley Abramson, Rolando Ramirez, Robert Schurr, Pierluigi Barone, Gregory Copenhaver, Otto Folkerts
